omissions.description: POST /todos does not return the specified validation error message when title is empty or missing.
omissions.reasoning: The request model `TodoCreate` declares `title: str`, so a missing title will trigger FastAPI/Pydantic validation with status 422 Unprocessable Entity, not 400 Bad Request. There is also no custom validation enforcing non-empty title text or producing the message 'The Title field is required.' for an empty string; an empty string would be accepted as a valid `str` and the todo would be created.

omissions.description: PUT /todos/{id} does not reject a request body whose id differs from the path id with 400 Bad Request.
omissions.reasoning: The update_todo route accepts TodoUpdate with an optional body field id, but it never compares todo_in.id to the path parameter id. It proceeds to update the todo after only checking existence/ownership, so a mismatched body id is ignored instead of causing a 400 response as required.
